scripts.preinstall: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'fs'; if (!fs.existsSync('apps/api') || !fs.existsSync('apps/web')) { console.warn('Warning: Ensure npm install is run from repository root with apps/api and apps/web structure present'); }"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix apps/api run build
